objectives.secondary_goal: Capture sector rotation opportunities while maintaining risk control
objectives.target_return: 15–25% over 1–3 years or 5% annual alpha vs VN-Index
objectives.risk_tolerance: Medium (emerging market risk, sector volatility, liquidity)

buy_conditions: Buy when price > SMA50 and SMA50 > SMA200 (uptrend confirmation)
Add on 5–8% pullbacks with rising volume
Fundamentals: EPS growth >15% YoY and ROE >15%

exit.take_profit: At +25–40% gain or when P/E > historical average + 1 std dev

risk_management.hedging: Prefer ETFs over derivatives for exposure balancing

time_horizon.strategy: Hold fundamentally strong companies through growth cycles while rotating sectors as macro shifts

monitoring.quarterly_check: Review earnings and sector rotation opportunities
monitoring.market_updates: Track interest rate policy, FDI inflows, consumption trends

golden_rules: Stay focused on medium-term fundamentals, not short-term noise
Avoid over-concentration in speculative small caps
Cut losses early, protect medium-term compounding
Rotate sectors based on macroeconomic and earnings cycle

sector_targets._comment: Target % allocation per sector (must sum to 100). Based on medium-term growth strategy with balanced risk. Banking 25% (core stability), Tech 20% (growth satellite), Consumer 15% (defensive), Real Estate 12% (value rotation), Manufacturing 10% (industrial recovery), Energy 8% (utility anchor), Materials 5%, Transport 3%, Healthcare 2%.

dynamic_request.new_plan_request: Suggest a medium-term investment plan (6 months – 3 years) with sector diversification and growth opportunities
